headline: CHC @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.54 at NYM 4.72, with a projected total of 9.25. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CHC +0.37, NYM +0.40), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.77, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Matthew Boyd has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Bo Bichette, Carson Benge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Brett Baty because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
